hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that implements a volatility-based dynamic LP fee, extracting a 20% protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta overrides. Includes a time-limited MEV protection module (active up to 2 minutes post-deployment) and optional pool extension support.
